message: 新しいコレ

name: Azel
message: 「Make it」

name: Synn
message: 「Instant ramen again?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't mind making it, but」

name: Azel
message: 「There's some for you too」

name: Paqy
message: 「What about yours truly?」

name: Azel
message: 「There's some for you too」

name: Synn
message: 「I appreciate it, but hasn't it been every single night since you came here? Eating nothing but that is bad for your nutrition」

name: Azel
message: 「It tastes good when you make it」

name: Synn
message: 「No, even if it tastes good, it's still a no」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll whip something up. Let's see what we've got」
Bacon. Eggs. Consomme. Tofu. Garlic. And sesame seeds, huh.

name: Synn
message: 「I'll take these tomatoes, onions, and scallions」
With this, I can make a simple tomato omelet and chilled tofu with natto.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Here you go, thanks as always」

name: Synn
message: 「What's with that look like you're dying to say something?」

name: Azel
message: 「Creepy」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Calling me creepy is harsh. I was just getting all emotional, wondering if this kid is Synn-chan's new 'this' and thinking it's finally come to this」

name: Azel
message: 「What is 'this'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, aren't you trying to spread baseless rumors again?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「They've got plenty of basis. It's a rare sight for Synn-chan to come shopping with a chick other than Nanaka-chan, after all」

name: Paqy
message: 「'Chick'? What century is this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel eats nothing but ramen all the time, so I just thought I'd make something else for her to eat」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Oh-ho. And how would you know a thing like that?」
I've got a really bad feeling about this!

name: Synn
message: 「Let's head back, A--」

name: Azel
message: 「Because he makes it for me every night」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Ho-ho. Little Synn makes ramen for you every night... Which means this girl is with little Synn every night. How about it, Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's right. Under the same roof all night long」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Oh-ho! All night long, you say!」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you convinced now」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「I see, I see, totally convinced. The roots and leaves are growing out nice and bushy... Poor little Nanaka」

name: Synn
message: 「Why bring up Nanaka now!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, poor thing, soba」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「However, I am an apostle of truth! I must report the facts calmly!」

name: Azel
message: 「The truth is important」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel just moved into Grand Palace Sakura, that's all!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Ho! Ho! Ho-ho!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel's dorm is under renovation so she had nowhere to live, that's literally it」

name: Azel
message: 「He negotiated with the chairwoman for me」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Hmm, hmm. Seeing a golden opportunity, he used his silver tongue to get you living in his place. I see, I see」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that true?」

name: Synn
message: 「No it's not!」
